name: foreach_add_scalar_list
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_foreach_add.ScalarList(...) -> Tensor[]. Applies foreach add between a Tensor list and a scalar list paired with the input list; it returns a newly allocated Tensor list without aliasing self. The correctness suite covers contiguous and noncontiguous floating inputs, exact overload dispatch, list-output values or in-place storage preservation, and mismatched list lengths where applicable.
